mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms_inspection qi INNER JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = qi.work_order_id WHERE qi.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND qi.status = '0'

SELECT qi.* FROM qms_inspection qi LEFT JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = qi.work_order_id LEFT JOIN base_item bi ON bi.item_id = wo.item_id
AND qi.inspection_no LIKE concat('%', #{inspectionNo}, '%')
AND bi.item_name LIKE concat('%', #{itemName}, '%')
AND qi.inspector LIKE concat('%', #{inspector}, '%')
ORDER BY qi.inspection_time DESC

SELECT qi.* FROM qms_inspection qi LEFT JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = qi.work_order_id LEFT JOIN base_item bi ON bi.item_id = wo.item_id
AND qi.inspection_no LIKE concat('%', #{inspectionNo}, '%')
AND bi.item_name LIKE concat('%', #{itemName}, '%')
AND qi.inspector LIKE concat('%', #{inspector}, '%')
AND (qi.inspector_user_id = #{inspectorUserId} OR (qi.status = '0' AND qi.inspector_user_id IS NULL))
AND qi.inspector_user_id = #{inspectorUserId}
AND qi.status = '0' AND qi.inspector_user_id IS NULL
AND qi.process_record_id = #{processRecordId}
ORDER BY qi.inspection_time DESC
